svg.title: A story in 12 passes
svg.desc: A TinyStories sample from an independently trained MLX NCM model sharpening over 12 passes; the last pass reads: Then, on a time, in a big forest, there was a little bunny named Kiki.

g.text: REAL OUTPUT · independently trained 87M MLX NCM, not the released checkpoint · 12 passes
Independently trained 87M MLX NCM; GPT-2 large generative perplexity 24.40. Unconditional TinyStories sample 0 of 16, seed 0,
Each row decodes the codes known after that pass and shows the first sentence. Sample 0 of the seed, shown without selection.
